anariya.p: [Na+ariya] (ti) CL=9 Anaya+iriya+a. Aya+na+iriya+a. See  Ariya.]. (1) Not noble. Not pure. Not innocent. Not good. Inferior or wicked. See Anariya. (Na)(2) An act that is inferior and wicked,that is not noble not pure,not innocent,not good. An act that is condemned by the noble or enlightened individuals. (3) To produce the  unbeneficial,  not producing any benefit. Such a person. Not noble or pure. Such a person. (a) Not a noble or enlightened person. An ordinary person.  (B) Not a good person. Not a pure person. Shameless person. A person without mortality. A person having ignoble habits. (C) Hermaphrodite. See Anariyapaṇḍaka.  Anariya anariya(ti) [na+ariya. Anariya+a.] (1) Adhered,reached,known and practiced by people who are neither good nor . Being the property of people who are neither good nor noble. See Anariya(1) meaning ṭha, ṭī. (na)(3) Acts that are not done by noble people, acts that are done by ignoble people , such as not donating ,not keeping virtues etc.
